short: The first Yorkist King of England, who won the throne during the Wars of the Roses and oversaw a period of recovery.
full:
Proclaimed king on 4 March 1461, Edward IV seized the throne from Henry VI after inheriting the Yorkist claim from his father. A charismatic and highly capable military commander, he decisively defeated Lancastrian forces at Towton to secure his crown.

Despite being briefly deposed in 1470 by a rebellion orchestrated by his former ally the Earl of Warwick, Edward regained power the following year, decisively crushing remaining opposition at Barnet and Tewkesbury. The remainder of his reign was marked by relative domestic peace and economic recovery, ending with his sudden death on 9 April 1483.
